title: Yung Kaplun and Lil Grayski Drop New Single "Don't Gotta Say"
htmlContent:
Canadian artists Yung Kaplun and Lil Grayski have released their latest collaboration, "Don't Gotta Say," ahead of their upcoming album "1715." The single has been a highly anticipated release among Toronto's music scene, as the two young artists have gained a reputation for standing out from the rest.

The song was initially conceived in Grayski's bedroom before being professionally recorded and mastered. It showcases the artists' passion for music and desire to express themselves through art.

At just 15 years old, Yung Kaplun has already garnered industry attention and co-signs from big names in the Canadian rap scene. Growing up in the Jane and Finch neighborhood of Toronto, he found solace in music after the loss of both his parents. With his determination and motivation, he has become one of the city's youngest rising stars.

"Don't Gotta Say" is a testament to the duo's talent and creativity and a promising sign of what's to come from their album release later this year.
